policy.groups: Disjoint directory families: two levels, three under annexB; shallower direct files labelled separately.
policy.enabled: No feature allowlist or disabled group list. All groups selectable. Non-negative Module execution unsupported; parse/early negatives use the native syntax gate.
policy.latest: Complete Map rerun after weak APIs:405/405, no failures, unsupported variants, crashes, timeouts or harness errors. Other family snapshots remain separate; no combined conformance rate
policy.coverage: Evidence fraction counts unique recorded outcomes, including unsupported and failures. It is not a pass rate or a claim that those sources executed. Family pass ratios require one complete report covering every family variant. Separate historical snapshots are never combined into a conformance pass rate.
policy.limitations: Reports can predate current code. File modification times are selection-order evidence, not execution timestamps. In-progress reports are excluded.
